- Slightly delay the hitbox activation of throw skill of the boss Defender

notes.title: Camera Optimize && Add Sprint Block Tutorial
notes.content:
- Add a new camera feature that allow lock target between camera and player so that camera will not be blocked by walls that easily. 
     If you don't like it, you can still turn it off in option/game settings.
- Add Sprint Block tutorial that teach players just sprint run to deal with machine guns.
- Fix a bug that enemies could stop combo when player is invincible when success perfect guard.

notes.title: Bug Fix and Sorry for That
notes.content:
- Fix the bug that game could not continue when exit game(Alt+F4 or cutoff power?) after finish level 1.
   If you have encountered this issue, please hit new game to restart. And that may delete current save data. Sorry for the inconvenient.

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
The playable demo contains one level. And it ends up with passing through the boss.
I will continue optimizing the camera and fighting experiences. Please feel free to comment and suggest.

Fixes in this update:
- Fix camera vertical rotate performance when the lock target get close.
- Add toughness ui to heavy enemies, showing when they will get hit recoiled.
- Slightly reduce the boss's attack speed.
- Add camera rotate sensitivity settings to the option menu.
